verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document issuing scoped or least-privilege API tokens or credentials for an agent. The only related item (sentry-docs-46) describes MCP tools defaulting to a constrained org/project and hiding discovery tools. That is an adjacent tool-surface control, not issuance of permission-scoped credentials, so it earns no credit.
